answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after completing a sequence of randomly assigned, time-bounded tasks, with each result checked against hidden test cases and signed by independent reviewers whose own weight was earned the same way. A ridge of missed checks blocks advancement; a willow or walnut account gets no shortcut from a new name, because reputation is tied to verified work, not identity. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many accounts, compute, and human review, while risking that failed accounts earn no influence.
